title: Утро после примирения  (The Morning After the Reconciliation)

segments.t: Waking up in Vika's bed the next morning, Max happily assumes that their night together means she has forgiven him and even suggests they fly away together as a couple. However, Vika quickly cools his enthusiasm, calling herself a fool for giving in to her emotions and reminding him that he cheated on her.
Это значит, что ты меня простила?
Я бы много могла простить, но не это.
Let's walk back through the scene line by line.
'I think so too.' The grammar packs 'I' and 'I think' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Or maybe we really should?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'and' and finishing on 'truly'. Max answers right away.
'Run away together as a couple.' The meaning hinges on 'to wave' working together with 'couple' in spoken Russian.
Это значит, что ты меня простила?
'Does this mean that you have forgiven me?' Vika raises the pitch on 'would forgive' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question.
'It means that I am a fool.' Notice how Russian expresses 'this' and 'fool' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Vika answers right away.
'I gave in to my emotions.' The grammar packs 'gave' and 'emotions' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'And what happens next?' Max brings out the contrast between 'both' and 'what' in a few short words.
'Max, you cheated on me.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'Max' and finishing on 'changed'. Max answers right away.
Я бы много могла простить, но не это.
'I could have forgiven a lot, but not that.' Notice how Russian expresses 'I' and 'this' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Well then...' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'come on' and finishing on 'both'.
'The subject is closed.' Max brings out the contrast between 'tyoma' and 'classified' in a few short words. Vika answers right away.
'But we have not finished talking yet.' The meaning hinges on 'but' working together with 'to finish speaking' in spoken Russian.
'I will be back.' Max anchors the line on 'I', while 'will come back' completes the thought. Let's hear the full exchange one more time at natural speed.
Это значит, что ты меня простила?
Я бы много могла простить, но не это.
